metadata.title: LLM Brand-Name Hallucination Benchmark v0.5 — raw scoring outputs
metadata.description: Per-cell scored outputs (975,192 rows) and aggregate analysis JSON for the LLM Brand-Name Hallucination Benchmark v0.5 (2026-05-26). Six frontier models (GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite). 1,200 candidate names x 6 conditions x 3 repeats = 129,600 generations. Headline: 97.01% of 50,327 verifiable USPTO citations are fabricated or mis-attributed (Wilson 95% CI 96.86-97.16%). Released so independent replicators can verify the headline without re-running ~$1,500 of API calls.
